title: Using zip(error_ids, events.values()) assumes the get_multi result preserves the input order; dict value order is not gu
description: Using zip(error_ids, events.values()) assumes the get_multi result preserves the input order; dict value order is not guaranteed to match error_ids, so event data can be paired with the wrong ID (missing nodes also shift alignment).

adjudication.why: NodeStorage.get_multi appends cached entries after uncached entries, so partial cache hits can reorder its values. Zipping those values with input error IDs assigns another event payload to an ID.
